- Surge buffer: 20% burst allowance above commit for emergency/autoscale (billed at committed rate until 125% then overage)

Action items from our side: send finalized term sheet and DocuSign link. From your side: confirm whether a 90-day price hold is acceptable or if you need a shorter window.

Jordan / Marcus —

Finance has run a quick scenario. We can land a market-competitive package that still protects unit economics. Recommended counter: 

- Commit: 1.2B tokens (we can ladder to 1.5B if they accept phased ramp schedule; see drawdown table)
- Discount: 15% on committed usage (first year) + 10% off incremental usage up to the surge buffer cap

- SLA / Latency: provide non-contractual platform performance targets for burst (p95 < 220ms for small payloads) and offer a Dedicated placement evaluation for hard SLA.

Legal flagged that DocuSign-ready term sheet should call out acceptance path and a 30-day cooling period for any mid-term commits. 

If Merit accepts principles above, we prepare term-sheet v2 and kick DocuSign. Finance is ok with the economics assuming phased ramp to 1.5B by month 6.
